faq: How is a starter kit different from a template?
A template is a finished look. A starter kit is the working foundation, like sign in, database and deployment, without a design, so your developers can build your own product on it.
Can I choose a different stack?
Yes. We can work with React, Next.js, Astro, Node.js, Python and PostgreSQL or MongoDB. Tell us your stack in the order form and we confirm what we can set up.
Do I own the starter kit?
Yes. The repository is created in your own account and you can use it for as many projects as you like. We keep no rights to it.
Is it ready for real users?
It follows common good practice for security and structure, but it is a starting point, not a finished product. You or your developers still add the features that make it yours.
